getResolver(string).details: Real signature takes the label string directly (inherited from IRegistry), NOT a         token ID — always look up at call-time since token IDs are mutable anyway.

params.anyId: The labelhash, token ID, or resource — the real registry accepts any of these               interchangeably and resolves internally.

grantRoles(uint256,uint256,address).details: Caller must hold the _ADMIN variant of each role being granted, scoped to `anyId`.

params.anyId: The labelhash, token ID, or resource of the name to scope the grant to.

grantRootRoles(uint256,address).details: Caller must hold the _ADMIN variant of each role being granted.         e.g. to grant ROLE_REGISTRAR, caller needs ROLE_REGISTRAR_ADMIN.

params.expiry: Absolute Unix timestamp when this registration expires.
params.label: Leaf label string — no dots, no parent.
params.owner: Address to receive the ERC-1155 name token.
params.resolver: Resolver for this name. Use the veri.eth PermissionedResolverImpl.
params.roleBitmap: EAC roles granted to `owner` on registration.
params.subregistry: Sub-registry for further delegation. Pass address(0) for leaf names.

returns.tokenId: The ERC-1155 token ID minted for this name. Requirements:   - Caller must hold ROLE_REGISTRAR (granted via grantRootRoles).   - Label must not already be REGISTERED or in EXPIRED grace period.

params.newExpiry: New absolute expiry timestamp. Requirements: Caller must hold ROLE_RENEW.
params.tokenId: Current token ID (resolve fresh — token IDs are mutable).

grantRoles(uint256,uint256,address).notice: Grant roles scoped to a specific name (unlike the resolver's equivalent, this is         NOT disabled on the registry).

grantRootRoles(uint256,address).notice: Grant roles on the root resource (the registry itself).

register(string,address,address,address,.notice: Register a leaf label under this registry.

revokeRoles(uint256,uint256,address).notice: Revoke roles scoped to a specific name.

revokeRootRoles(uint256,address).notice: Revoke roles on the root resource.
